tagline: Alkermes plc is a fully integrated, global biopharmaceutical company with a portfolio of proprietary products in psychiatry, addiction, and neurology.
hero_kpi_rationale: Net product revenue is the primary driver of the company's financial performance, reflecting the market success of its four major proprietary drugs (VIVITROL, ARISTADA, ARISTADA INITIO and LYBALVI).

kpis.name: Net Product Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from the sale of the company's drugs after deductions.
kpis.description: Net product sales increased by $101.1 million, or 9.3%, to $1,184.6 million in 2025, compared to $1,083.5 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in net product sales.

kpis.name: Net Income from Continuing Operations
kpis.explanation: The company's profit after taxes from its core operations.
kpis.description: Net income from continuing operations decreased by $130.5 million to $241.7 million in 2025, compared to $372.1 million in 2024.

kpis.name: Total Expenses
kpis.explanation: Total cost of the company's operations.
kpis.description: Total expenses increased by $84.9 million to $942.9 million in 2025, compared to $858.0 million in 2024.

kpis.name: Manufacturing and Royalty Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenue from licensing and manufacturing agreements with third parties.
kpis.description: Manufacturing and royalty revenues decreased by $182.8 million, or 38.6%, to $291.3 million in 2025, compared to $474.1 million in 2024. The decline was primarily due to the expiration of the royalty on net sales of INVEGA SUSTENNA in August 2024.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in manufacturing and royalty revenues.

kpis.name: Gross Product Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue before deductions for product sales.
kpis.description: Gross product sales increased by $93.0 million, or 4.4%, to $2,212.5 million in 2025, compared to $2,119.5 million in 2024.

kpis.name: Total Adjustments to Product Sales
kpis.explanation: Total amount deducted from gross sales to arrive at net sales.
kpis.description: Total adjustments to product sales decreased by $8.1 million, or 0.8%, to $1,027.9 million in 2025, compared to $1,036.0 million in 2024.

kpis.name: VIVITROL Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of the VIVITROL drug.
kpis.description: VIVITROL net sales increased by $10.6 million, or 2.3%, to $467.9 million in 2025, compared to $457.3 million in 2024.

kpis.name: ARISTADA and ARISTADA INITIO Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of ARISTADA and ARISTADA INITIO drugs.
kpis.description: ARISTADA and ARISTADA INITIO net sales increased by $23.8 million, or 6.9%, to $370.0 million in 2025, compared to $346.2 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Growth in ARISTADA and ARISTADA INITIO sales.

kpis.name: LYBALVI Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of the LYBALVI drug.
kpis.description: LYBALVI net sales increased by $66.7 million, or 23.8%, to $346.7 million in 2025, compared to $280.0 million in 2024.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The report states that fluctuations in interest rates may impact the market value of the company's investments, but the impact is considered immaterial.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: The report indicates that fluctuations in exchange rates may have a significant impact on the company's revenues, particularly with respect to foreign sales.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The report mentions that the company does not have any significant liquidity issues, as it has sufficient cash to fund its operations.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The report states that the company has strict credit policies for its investments and that credit risks are considered low.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The report notes that the company is subject to strict regulations in the healthcare sector, which may impact its operations.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies is present in Alkermes plc's 10-K filing.
